about: What catches a misreading, against what a reader would say (#162). Every answer has the shape capsulet-proposer gives a direct quote, asked under a pinned query. Read by crates/kernel/tests/misreading_corpus.rs and by the contract-clauses pack's own test.
agreement:
1. Definitions
"Affiliate" means an entity that controls, or is controlled by, a party.
4. Fees
The Customer shall pay the fees within 30 days of each invoice. Fees are non-refundable, except as provided in Section 11.
7. Liability
Subject to Section 8, the Supplier is liable for all damages.
8. Limitation
Notwithstanding Section 7, the Supplier is not liable for indirect damages.
9. Termination
Either party may terminate this agreement, provided that all fees are paid.
10. Assignment
The Supplier may assign this agreement to an Affiliate.
11. Refunds
The Supplier shall refund prepaid fees if it ends this agreement early.
12. Renewal
This agreement renews for one year unless either party objects.
13. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of Ontario.
14. Prices
The Supplier may raise prices once a year. Any increase needs the Customer's written consent.
